{{Quote|The government of Corellia is beyond corrupt! They can exterminate families like they are vermin! I'm going to take my little family and go to live in the woods. I will have my revenge! The world will know the name of Raynod Menar!!|[[Raynod Menar]]|<ref name="SWG:DFR" />}}
The '''cave-dwellers''' formed an anti-government and criminal organization active on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==History==
{{Quote|Listen, they know that they are in trouble. A transmission just came from there threatening to kill their hostages. Do whatever you must to save them. I'll transfer all the information that I have to you.|[[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Talte]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:DFtC" />}}
By the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the cave-dwellers were a [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] anti-establishment and criminal group that opposed the Corellian government. At some point, their leader [[Raynod Menar]] decided to move all the members of the movement in the wilderness of the planet Corellia in order to live in isolation from the rest of society. They eventually took shelter in a [[Psychotic cave-dwellers' cave|cave]] in the [[Nomad Mountains|Thaos Mountains]].<ref name="SWG:DFR" />

[[File:Psychotic_cave-dwellers_2.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Psychotic cave-dwellers keeping hostages in a cave.]]
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> psychotic cave-dwellers captured two groups of hikers in the Thaos Mountains.<ref name="SWG:DFtC" /> [[Ilyamo]] and other hikers were kept as hostages in the dwellers' cave.<ref name="SWG:DR">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Disappearances: Rescue|Corellia}}</ref> [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Talte]] of the [[Corellian Security Force]] therefore hired a spacer to investigate the disappearances of the hikers.<ref name="SWG:DGI">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other}}Legacy Quest: "Disappearances: Gathering Information</ref> The spacer fought several cave-dwellers at the spot where the second group disappeared. From a communicator found on a body, the spacer managed to triangulate a signal to the cave.<ref name="SWG:DFtC" /> The CorSec finally assaulted the cave and freed the hostages. Raynod Menar was killed by the spacer during the attack.<ref name="SWG:DFR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The cave-dwellers appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:DFtC" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The cave-dwellers were added to the game with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 28 Notes for April 26, 2006|Publish 28]]," on [[April 26]], [[2006]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-What's On Deck! Publish 28 Update Notes, April 26th">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=Announcements&message.id=3077&jump=true|text=What's On Deck! Publish 28 Update Notes, April 26th}}</ref>
